Q: Capture 48MP/50MP/100MP images of vivo X60 pro+ with Camera2 API A:

To capture high resolution images using camera2

Check for, if characteristics for that cameraID contains SCALER_STREAM_CONFIGURATION_MAP_MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION

If it’s not null then get the exact width and height(usually a dumpsys works) and set the target to imageReader()

And set SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE to SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_MAXIMUM_RESOLUTION on capture builder and verify.

Q: Enum-like arguments in R A:

The native and also best way to do this seems to be the rlang::arg_match0 function.

You also get suggestions if you take the value wrong:

> gender <- function(value) {
+   rlang::arg_match0(value, c("M", "F"))
+ }
> "M"==gender("M")
[1] TRUE
> "M"==gender("F")
[1] FALSE
> "M"==gender("m")
Error in `gender()`:
! `value` must be one of "M" or "F", not "m".
ℹ Did you mean "M"?

Q: DuplicateError with name 'null' when trying to pivot a Polars DataFrame A:

This happens because there are nulls in your "value" parameter. Make sure to drop rows where the value columns are all nulls (filter -> all horizontal -> is_not_null -> pivot).

Also for the OP it makes more sense to pivot on A and B separately then join by DATE rather than putting the values in a list.
